verdict: One 11-game sample cannot establish skill. On this sample the model beats a coin flip on Brier but is WORSE than quoting the sample base rate, its spread opinions are under-dispersed by a factor of about four relative to realised margins, and its picks benefited from luck. Nothing here clears a validation gate.
